violations.text: Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (bagels, bread) in the refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated items during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

Per interview, eggs are cooked in advance and held on counter prior to service Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Eggs were placed in refrigerator. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026
Leaf debris was observed under the dumpster. New Violation. Correct By: 08/13/2026

A chemical spray bottle was observed hanging on the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. PIC removed bottle. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025
The ice bucket was observed not stored inverted. PIC inverted and placed on a pan. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/19/2025

An accumulation of dirt and leaf debris was observed in the dumpster enclosure, with overgrown plants in the raised area behind the dumpster. Refuse area shall be maintained free of debris to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2025
Dirt and debris were observed in the dumpster area. Refuse areas must be maintained clean to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/15/2025
